title: 第15章 挖大生蚝
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
铁蛋也不全是要黏着可爱妹妹。

    刚才奶奶可说了，要去赶海，要去挖挖挖！

    等从饭桌上下来，小破孩立马就去灶房拖大铁锹。

    垒灶台的工具都还没还呢，赵玉兰就得问问婆婆，“妈，那咱还开锅吗？”

    搁老家，哪一户要是分家出去单过，哪怕有灶台都得重新开锅。

    饶是家底子穷得响叮当都得想法子买点猪肉回来擦擦锅，表示天天有油水，都是冲着好兆头去的。

    这倒是个事儿，虽然现在移风易俗不让讲究迷信，但也得和灶王爷说一声啊。

    蔡老太吩咐儿子，“你们来回一趟差不多能赶上晌午饭，今儿去食堂买点硬菜。”

    她往抽屉一指，“粮票和钱都在那，自个拿去。”

    上辈子她管家也累得慌。

    钱虽然是攥手里头了，但花钱的事哪有够数的呢，一到花钱的时候就得削尖脑袋规划着怎么节约。

    而且一管钱就舍不得花钱也就算了，出现个零头还得想法子再添点凑个整数。

    现在抓大放小，她只是失去了花钱的隐私，没失去花钱的权利，都是一样的。

    儿媳妇应该高兴坏了吧。

    哪个当儿媳妇的都梦想当家的那一天。

    可媳妇熬成婆哪有那么容易，她主动放权得了。

    赵玉兰大惊失色，扑过来摇蔡老太肩膀，“妈，你实话实说，发生什么事了，你别吓我啊，妈妈妈妈妈妈！”

    她着急质问魏建业，“是不是上医院的时候，反而是妈查出啥来了？”

    话落眼泪簌簌的往下掉：“妈，没了你我咋活啊。”

    蔡老太没好气的推开儿媳妇，“别哭嚎了，比起你男人，我才是真没事的那一个。”

    魏建业这回敢拍心窝子保证了，“妈好着呢，”

    赵玉兰擦眼泪，纳闷问：“那...那是为啥啊，怎么忽然就不管家了呢？”

    她咬咬牙说：“妈，我哪做得不对你就说。说句掏心窝子的话，我打从进这个家以后跟着你活，一点事都不带多操心的，你让我干啥买啥做啥，回回都没叫我吃亏过。”

    当然，赵玉兰偶尔也会做当家做主的梦，但想想不犯法啊，她还是拎得清的。

    此时蔡老太的背已经快被铁蛋戳烂了。

    小破孩望眼欲穿，就等着走呢。
content_en:
Tiedan is not all about clinging to his cute sister.

Grandma just said that she has to go to the sea and dig, dig, dig!

As soon as he got off the dining table, the little boy immediately went to the kitchen to drag the big shovel.

Even the tools for building the stove had not been returned, so Zhao Yulan had to ask her mother-in-law, "Mom, should we still cook?"

In my hometown, if any household separates and goes out to live alone, even if they have a stove, they have to start the cooking again.

Rao Shi's family was so poor that he had to find a way to buy some pork to wipe the pot, which meant that there was oil and water every day, which was a good sign.

This is a matter of fact. Although the customs are changing now and superstition is not allowed, I still have to talk to the Kitchen God.

Mrs. Cai told her son, "You can make a round trip in time for lunch. Today, go to the canteen to buy some hard food."

She pointed to the drawer and said, "The food stamps and money are there, take them yourself."

In her previous life, her housekeeper was also exhausted.

Although you have money in your hands, you can never spend enough money. When it comes time to spend money, you have to sharpen your head and plan how to save.

And it doesn’t matter if you don’t want to spend money once you have money. If there is a change, you have to find a way to add some to make up the whole number.

Now, she has only lost the privacy to spend money, but she has not lost the right to spend money. It is the same.

My daughter-in-law must be very happy.

Every daughter-in-law dreams of the day when she becomes the head of the family.

But it's not that easy for a daughter-in-law to become a mother-in-law. She can take the initiative to delegate power.

Zhao Yulan was shocked and rushed over to shake Old Mrs. Cai's shoulders, "Mom, tell the truth, what happened, don't scare me, mom, mom, mom!"

She asked Wei Jianye anxiously, "Did Mom find out something when she went to the hospital?"

Tears fell down her cheeks as she said this: "Mom, how can I live without you?"

Mrs. Cai pushed her daughter-in-law away angrily, "Stop crying. Compared to your man, I am the one who is really fine."

Wei Jianye dared to reassure himself this time, "Mom is fine,"

Zhao Yulan wiped her tears and asked in confusion: "Then... why is that? Why do you suddenly stop caring about home?"

She gritted her teeth and said, "Mom, just tell me if I did anything wrong. To be honest, I have lived with you since I entered this house, and I have not worried about anything. I have bought and done whatever you asked me to do, and I have never suffered a loss."

Of course, Zhao Yulan occasionally dreams of being the master of the family, but she can still handle it without breaking the law.

At this time, Mrs. Cai's back was almost broken by the iron egg.

The little boy was eager to see what was going on, just waiting to leave.
